e2e.intro: 40 approved small-molecule drugs (9 since withdrawn) were each registered by structure alone and run through the whole pipeline. Every measurement of the drug itself was removed from the screening reference set first, so each prediction was made without the answer. The drug's own measured hERG potency is the ground truth.

cards.title: hERG potency by read-across
cards.question: Before a hERG assay is commissioned, is this compound likely to block the hERG (Kv11.1) channel, and at roughly what potency?
cards.role: Decision support for study selection and design only. It never becomes a study record, a readiness count or part of a submission, and it never substitutes for the in vitro hERG assay required by ICH S7B.
cards.out_of_scope: peptides, antibodies and other biologics; compounds with no near analogues; and any use as evidence of safety or of a safety margin
cards.validation: Validated on 2263 held-out compounds from CardioSafe multi-channel cardiac ion-channel benchmark (v1 labels, tan70 split) (19266 reference, 812 calibration), source https://github.com/AppliedScientific/CardioSafe-benchmark. Applicability-domain coverage: predicted 756 of 2263 (33.4%); the rest declined (too few close analogues). External predictivity (in-domain): RMSE 0.6787 (95% CI 0.6163 to 0.742) pIC50, MAE 0.4437, R² 0.381 (95% CI 0.2719 to 0.4697), Spearman 0.6462. Golbraikh-Tropsha: R² 0.381, slope 0.9914, criterion -0.0073 — does not pass. Y-randomisation (labels shuffled): R² -0.7091, RMSE 1.1278 — predictivity collapses, so the signal is not chance correlation. Conformal prediction intervals: 80% interval ±0.6578 covers 76.2%, 90% interval ±0.9908 covers 88.5%. Downstream binary gate (blocker at the stated cut): sensitivity 0.832, specificity 0.7164, balanced accuracy 0.7742, MCC 0.5457, AUROC 0.8204.

cards.title: Organ-system liability posteriors
cards.question: Which organ-system liabilities is this compound most likely to show in animals, before any study is run?
cards.role: An ordinal prior for prioritising studies and reading results. Never a finding, a readiness count, or part of a submission.
cards.out_of_scope: use as a calibrated probability, or as evidence of safety

cards.title: Observation forecast
cards.question: Which specific organ-system observations is a repeat-dose study most likely to report for this compound?
cards.role: Decision support for study design and result review. Never a finding or a submission; each row is placed only where a cited source puts it.
cards.out_of_scope: use as a calibrated probability, or any claim a finding will occur

cards.title: Aqueous solubility estimated from structure (ESOL)
cards.question: Roughly how soluble in water is this structure, before any measurement?
cards.role: A developability read and a formulation flag; never a specification.
cards.out_of_scope: salts and permanently charged species, and any use as a measured value

cards.title: Predicted microsomal unbound fraction from lipophilicity
cards.question: What fraction of compound is free in a microsomal incubation, so apparent clearance can be corrected for non-specific binding?
cards.role: One correction term inside the in vitro to in vivo clearance chain; off unless a study selects it.
cards.out_of_scope: hepatocyte, S9 or plasma matrices, and any compound whose lipophilicity sits outside the cited range, where it should be measured

cards.title: Steady-state volume of distribution from plasma and tissue unbound fractions
cards.question: What steady-state volume of distribution follows from this compound's plasma and tissue binding?
cards.role: A disposition input to the exposure simulation when no measured volume exists.
cards.out_of_scope: species whose physiological volumes are not held, where it is refused rather than approximated

cards.title: Clearance projected between species by simple allometry on body weight
cards.question: What clearance would this compound have in a species that has not been dosed?
cards.role: A disposition input where that species has no measured clearance; the exposure simulated from it is marked as projected.
cards.out_of_scope: species-divergent enzymes or transporters, and any species with a measured clearance of its own

cards.title: Steady-state volume of distribution projected between species by unbound fraction
cards.question: What volume of distribution would this compound have in another species?
cards.role: A disposition input where that species has no measured volume; it carries the projection, not a measurement.
cards.out_of_scope: drugs with a species-divergent transporter or tissue-binding protein

cards.title: Minimal physiologically based model: blood, liver, rapidly and slowly equilibrating tissue
cards.question: What plasma exposure would a given dose produce in a given species?
cards.role: The exposure a study is sized against before any animal is dosed; it does not set a dose.
cards.out_of_scope: tissue exposure outside the liver, saturable metabolism, transporters, and enterohepatic recycling

cards.title: Parameter uncertainty propagated by Monte Carlo sampling
cards.question: How far does declared input uncertainty move the simulated exposure?
cards.role: Shows the spread the declared inputs imply; it widens or narrows confidence, it does not add information.
cards.out_of_scope: uncertainty that was not declared, and structural error in the model itself

cards.title: Systemic exposure at a dose from observed dose-normalised toxicokinetics
cards.question: What exposure does a given dose produce in a species where toxicokinetics were observed at other doses?
cards.role: Places a projected effect on an exposure scale so studies can be compared; it is not measured toxicokinetics.
cards.out_of_scope: doses beyond the observed range, and any endpoint whose formation is saturable

cards.title: Cross-species projection of an endpoint's critical exposure
cards.question: At what exposure would this endpoint appear in a species that has not been dosed?
cards.role: Sizes and prioritises a study in a new species; it never stands in for running it.
cards.out_of_scope: endpoints a species cannot express, and any case where exposure conservation is known to fail

cards.title: Pharmacologically active dose by steady-state reverse dosimetry: daily dose = (EC50 x MW / fu) x CL x 24 h / F
cards.question: At roughly what daily dose does on-target pharmacology begin?
cards.role: Orients where pharmacology starts when planning a dose range; it is not a NOAEL and sets no starting dose.
cards.out_of_scope: any toxicity prediction, and any use as a safety limit

cards.title: Structural change indicated by a failing predicted property
cards.question: Which structural change does the literature tie to the property that failed?
cards.role: A hypothesis for a chemist to test; never an instruction and never a predicted potency.
cards.out_of_scope: the magnitude of any change, and any property with no cited tactic
